verdict.rationale: Warp documents an HR/payroll API with endpoints to create and send candidate offers and to create benefit deductions for workers. It also markets a Warp Agent that 'takes onboarding' and MCP access for external agents, so some agent- and API-driven onboarding exists. However, no evidence shows API endpoints for creating the employee record, setting compensation, or configuring worker tax setup end-to-end, and advanced production API use is gated to Enterprise. Missing for 10: documented create-worker/employee endpoint, compensation setup endpoint, worker tax (withholding) setup endpoint, an end-to-end onboarding flow via API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup

citations.quote: Endpoints for managing candidate offers. Create and send offers, list existing offers, and manage their lifecycle.
Create Benefit Deduction: Create a benefit deduction for a worker.
Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits.
Use Warp from the agents your team already runs. Claude, ChatGPT, and any client that speaks MCP.
